senses.en: A portable computer with a screen that folds over its keyboard.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on laptop computer.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论笔记本电脑。

ex.en: The reading connects laptop computer with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把笔记本电脑和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: laptop charger｜笔记本电脑充电器
tip: laptop是便携电脑；desktop通常指台式电脑。

senses.en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a qualified dentist.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有执业资格的牙医。

ex.en: The author returns to a qualified dentist when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有执业资格的牙医。

col: a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

senses.en: Repeated activity done to improve a skill.
A usual or established way of doing something.
The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.

ex.en: Our professor circled regular practice on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了定期练习。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around regular practice.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕定期练习展开说明。

tip: 英式名词用practice，动词用practise；美式均用practice。

senses.en: Suffering from a disease or feeling unwell.
In a bad or unkind way.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on seriously ill.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论病得很重。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of seriously ill.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得病得很重这个例子。

tip: 表示生病时通常作表语：be ill。

senses.en: The event or process of a baby being born.
The beginning of something new.

ex.en: I copied date of birth into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把出生日期抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used date of birth to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用出生日期来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: the birth of a movement｜一场运动的诞生
tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

senses.en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level.
To get up from sitting or lying down.
An increase in amount, level, or value.

ex.en: The professor asked us to rise steadily.
ex.zh: 教授让我们稳步上升。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to rise steadily.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得稳步上升。

col: a rise in prices｜物价上涨
tip: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。

senses.en: To think something is probably true without being certain.
To imagine a situation in order to consider its consequences.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer suppose that during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时假设；认为。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to suppose that.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得假设；认为。

col: be supposed to do｜应该做；按安排做
tip: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。

senses.en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone.
Owned or managed independently of the government.
Not intended to be known or shared with others.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on private property.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论私有财产。

ex.en: The reading connects private property with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把私有财产和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。

senses.en: the number equal to a thousand thousands

ex.en: Office hours began with a million people.
ex.zh: 答疑从一百万人开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a million people with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一百万人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 具体数词后million不加s；millions of表示数百万。

senses.en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.
The study and practice of treating and preventing illness.

ex.en: I copied preventive medicine into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把预防医学抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects preventive medicine with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把预防医学和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

senses.en: The process of gaining knowledge or skills through study or experience.
Knowledge gained through extensive study.

ex.en: Our professor circled lifelong learning on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了终身学习。

ex.en: A campus survey used lifelong learning to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用终身学习来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: a steep learning curve｜陡峭的学习曲线
tip: 通常不可数；强调学习过程，knowledge强调所掌握的知识。

senses.en: having no doubt about something
definitely going to happen
particular but not named or fully described

ex.en: I copied certain of into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把对……有把握抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used certain of to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用对……有把握来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

senses.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells
a tool shaped like a gun that releases a substance

ex.en: The textbook introduces a loaded gun in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了装有弹药的枪。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a loaded gun.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕装有弹药的枪展开说明。

col: a loaded gun｜装有弹药的枪
tip: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。

senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important
Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on medical care.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医疗护理。

ex.en: The author returns to medical care when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了医疗护理。

tip: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

senses.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time
A particular way of doing something
Make or shape something, often using simple materials

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about out of fashion.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于过时的的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of out of fashion.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得过时的这个例子。

col: in a similar fashion｜以类似的方式
tip: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

ex.en: Our professor circled heart disease on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了心脏病。

ex.en: The author returns to heart disease when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了心脏病。

col: at the heart of｜处于……的核心
tip: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

senses.en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.

ex.en: Our professor circled neat handwriting on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了工整的笔迹。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around neat handwriting.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕工整的笔迹展开说明。

tip: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: The textbook introduces music festival in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了音乐节。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around music festival.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕音乐节展开说明。

col: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: to join things together or link them electronically
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: The assignment is to connect to the internet, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先连接互联网，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to connect to the internet.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得连接互联网。

col: connect to the internet｜连接互联网
connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来
connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface
a score showing the quality of a student's work
to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work

ex.en: The professor explained mark with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了痕迹。

ex.en: A reading on academic research uses mark when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了痕迹。

tip: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: Office hours began with flu symptoms.
ex.zh: 答疑从流感症状开始。

ex.en: The author returns to flu symptoms when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了流感症状。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.

ex.en: I copied online advertisement into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把网络广告抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around online advertisement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕网络广告展开说明。

tip: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

senses.en: A formal talk given to an audience.
The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on freedom of speech.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论言论自由。

ex.en: A campus survey used freedom of speech to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用言论自由来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

senses.en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.

ex.en: The textbook introduces opening paragraph in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了开头段。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of opening paragraph.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得开头段这个例子。

tip: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。

senses.en: An opportunity to do something.
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a chance to learn in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学习的机会。

ex.en: A campus survey used a chance to learn to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用学习的机会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.

ex.en: Our professor circled pencil drawing on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了铅笔画。

ex.en: The author returns to pencil drawing when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了铅笔画。

tip: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: a place serving meals in a school or workplace
a container used to carry drinking water outdoors

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on school canteen.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论学校食堂。

ex.en: The author returns to school canteen when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学校食堂。

tip: 英式英语中常指食堂；美式英语常用cafeteria。

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: The assignment is to solve a problem, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先解决问题，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers solve a problem before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要解决问题。

tip: solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

senses.en: To have a different opinion from someone else.
To give different information or results.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to disagree with someone.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求不同意某人的看法。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to disagree with someone.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们不同意某人的看法。

col: disagree with someone｜不同意某人的看法
disagree about something｜在某事上意见不合
tip: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

senses.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
To write a book, report, or other written work.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a bestselling author.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于畅销书作家的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bestselling author.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论畅销书作家的材料。

col: the author of a novel｜一部小说的作者
tip: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

ex.en: Office hours began with a bar of soap.
ex.zh: 答疑从一块肥皂开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bar of soap.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一块肥皂的材料。

col: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂
tip: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

senses.zh: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
senses.en: Having many bright colours

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
senses.en: Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details

ex.en: Our professor circled colourful flowers on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了色彩鲜艳的花朵。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around colourful flowers.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕色彩鲜艳的花朵展开说明。

col: a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物
a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

senses.en: as stated or reported by someone or something
following a rule, plan, or particular standard

ex.en: After the lecture, we used according to in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了根据。

ex.en: A reading on academic research uses according to when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于学术研究的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了根据。

col: according to the rules｜按照规则
tip: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

senses.en: to make something clear or easy to understand
to give or be the reason why something happens

ex.en: The assignment is to explain why, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先解释为什么，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers explain why before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要解释为什么。

col: explain something to someone｜向某人解释某事
tip: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

senses.en: Used when something may happen or may be true.
Used with can or could to emphasise possibility or difficulty.

ex.en: I wrote possibly on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把possibly和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up possibly while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了可能。

tip: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

senses.en: A reproduction, or one example of a book or document
To reproduce something or imitate someone's actions
Written material prepared for publication or advertising

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a digital copy.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于电子副本的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a digital copy.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得电子副本这个例子。

tip: 复数为copies；广告文案义的copy通常不可数。

senses.en: A member of the police.
A member of the armed forces with authority to command.
Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.

ex.en: I copied police officer into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把警察抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of police officer.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得警察这个例子。

tip: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The lab instructions say to increase by.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求增加了。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to increase by.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来增加了。

col: an increase in demand｜需求的增长
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

senses.en: To be owned by someone
To have a proper place or category
To feel accepted as part of a group

ex.en: The lab instructions say to belong in a museum.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求应放在博物馆。

ex.en: The reading asks you to belong in a museum and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你应放在博物馆，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: belong in a museum｜应放在博物馆
feel you belong｜感到有归属感
tip: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

senses.en: A device that records and plays sound using magnetic tape.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used tape-recorder in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了磁带录音机。

ex.en: Students who can explain tape-recorder usually follow the rest of a lecture on technological change.
ex.zh: 能解释磁带录音机的学生，通常跟得上一节关于技术变革的讲座。

col: a portable tape-recorder｜便携式磁带录音机
a cassette tape-recorder｜盒式磁带录音机
tip: 现代通常写作tape recorder，不加连字符。

senses.en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container.
Gas used as fuel for heating or cooking.
Petrol used to power vehicles, in American English.

ex.en: I copied greenhouse gas into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把温室气体抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss greenhouse gas.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论温室气体的材料。

tip: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

senses.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to celebrate a birthday.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求庆祝生日。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to celebrate a birthday.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们庆祝生日。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration.
To indicate that something may be true.

ex.en: The assignment is to suggest a solution, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先提出解决方案，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to suggest a solution.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们提出解决方案。

col: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案
tip: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

senses.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.
A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing.
Having a pleasant sound resembling music.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a stage musical in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了舞台音乐剧。

ex.en: The author returns to a stage musical when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了舞台音乐剧。

tip: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: The assignment is to expect to do something, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先预计做某事，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers expect to do something before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要预计做某事。

col: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事
tip: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex.en: Our professor circled bone strength on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了骨骼强度。

ex.en: The author returns to bone strength when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了骨骼强度。

tip: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。

senses.en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students
to give an educational talk to an audience
to criticize someone at length about their behaviour

ex.en: Our morning lecture met in the science building.
ex.zh: 我们的早课讲座在科学楼进行。

ex.en: The lecture explained how glaciers record changes in climate over thousands of years.
ex.zh: 这场讲座解释了冰川如何记录数千年来的气候变化。

col: lecture someone about｜就某事训斥某人
tip: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

senses.en: the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college

ex.en: New students toured the campus before classes began.
ex.zh: 新生在开学前参观了校园。

ex.en: The reading describes how campus design can help students from different majors meet.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读描述了校园设计如何帮助不同专业的学生相遇交流。

tip: 表示“在校园内”通常用on campus，不加冠词。

senses.en: Careful study aimed at discovering facts or developing knowledge.
To study a subject carefully to discover information.

ex.en: She joined a research group in her second year.
ex.zh: 她在二年级加入了一个研究小组。

ex.en: The passage compares two research methods used to study sleep in college students.
ex.zh: 文章比较了两种用于研究大学生睡眠的研究方法。

tip: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。

senses.en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea
test ideas or methods to see what happens

ex.en: The lab experiment took the whole afternoon.
ex.zh: 这次实验用了整个下午。

ex.en: Students had to say whether the experiment controlled every factor that could change the result.
ex.zh: 学生必须说明实验是否控制了每一个可能改变结果的因素。

col: experiment with materials｜尝试使用各种材料
tip: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: one of the two main periods of an academic year

ex.en: The semester starts the last Monday in August.
ex.zh: 这学期从八月的最后一个星期一开始。

ex.en: Tuition for the semester is due before students can register for the next term.
ex.zh: 学生必须在注册下一学期之前缴清本学期学费。

tip: 通常指一学年两学期中的一学期，不等于半年。

senses.en: A piece of work someone is required to complete.
The act of giving someone a task, role, or place.

ex.en: The assignment is due on Friday at noon.
ex.zh: 这份作业周五中午前截止。

ex.en: The assignment asks students to summarize the lecture and then challenge one claim.
ex.zh: 这份作业要求学生先概述讲座，再质疑其中一个主张。

col: complete an assignment｜完成作业或任务
tip: 指具体作业时可数；homework通常不可数。

senses.en: an agreed plan or rule guiding decisions and actions
a contract describing the insurance cover someone has bought

ex.en: The college changed its attendance policy this year.
ex.zh: 学院今年修改了出勤政策。

ex.en: The lecture asked whether public policy should weigh economic growth against environmental cost.
ex.zh: 讲座问到公共政策是否应当在经济增长与环境代价之间权衡。

tip: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。

senses.en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: The seminar compared student culture on two campuses.
ex.zh: 研讨课比较了两所学校的学生文化。

ex.en: Historians study how culture changes when people move and bring new customs with them.
ex.zh: 历史学者研究当人们迁徙并带去新习俗时，文化如何变化。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: An angry disagreement between people.
A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.

ex.en: Her paper led with a clear argument.
ex.zh: 她的论文以一个清晰的论点开头。

ex.en: In the listening, the professor said the argument was weak because it rested on a single study.
ex.zh: 听力里，教授说这个论点站不住，因为它只依赖一项研究。

col: a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据
tip: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

senses.en: a judgement formed after considering facts or evidence
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: The conclusion should follow from the evidence.
ex.zh: 结论应当从证据中得出。

ex.en: The author reached a conclusion that later studies have only partly supported.
ex.zh: 作者得出的结论只得到了后来研究的部分支持。

tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

senses.en: to cause a change in someone or something
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Lack of sleep can affect your score on a quiz.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会影响你在小测中的成绩。

ex.en: The study measured how screen time can affect attention during an evening lecture.
ex.zh: 这项研究测量了屏幕时间如何影响晚间讲座中的注意力。

col: deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人
tip: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

senses.en: A change or result caused by something.
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: We measured the effect of caffeine on focus.
ex.zh: 我们测量了咖啡因对专注力的影响。

ex.en: A small sample can hide the real effect and make a weak result look important.
ex.zh: 样本太小会掩盖真实影响，让一个微弱的结果看起来很重要。

col: have an effect on｜对……有影响
tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

senses.en: a helpful or positive effect of something
to help someone or receive help or an advantage
money provided by the government to people needing support

ex.en: Office hours are a real benefit for new students.
ex.zh: 对新生来说，答疑时间是实实在在的好处。

ex.en: The passage weighs the benefit of the new transit line against its cost to nearby parks.
ex.zh: 文章权衡了新公交线路的好处及其对附近公园的代价。

tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.en: The way parts are arranged and connected within a whole.
Something built from connected parts, such as a bridge.
Arrange parts or activities into an organised whole.

ex.en: Outline the structure before you draft the essay.
ex.zh: 起草文章之前，先列出结构。

ex.en: The lecture showed how the structure of a cell limits what can pass through its membrane.
ex.zh: 讲座说明了细胞的结构如何限制物质穿过细胞膜。

tip: structure既可作名词，也可作动词表示组织、安排。

senses.en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result.
Treat materials or information through a series of organised steps.

ex.en: Registration is a slow process in the first week.
ex.zh: 开学第一周，注册是一个缓慢的过程。

ex.en: The process described in the passage turns raw data into a chart the class can read.
ex.zh: 文章描述的过程把原始数据变成全班都能看懂的图表。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: in the process of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is.
To discover or establish something through examination.
To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.

ex.en: Identify the claim before you look at the chart.
ex.zh: 看图表之前，先识别出主张。

ex.en: Students learn to identify the assumption that an argument never states out loud.
ex.zh: 学生学习识别论点从未明说的那个假设。

tip: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。

senses.en: To state exactly what a word or idea means.
To establish the limits, duties, or nature of something clearly.
To be the quality that makes someone or something distinctive.

ex.en: Define the term before you use it in the essay.
ex.zh: 在文章里使用这个术语之前，先给它下定义。

ex.en: Researchers define the variable so that another lab can repeat the same measurement.
ex.zh: 研究者界定变量，以便另一个实验室能重复同样的测量。

col: define a term｜给术语下定义
tip: define A as B表示“将A定义为B”。

senses.en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.

ex.en: She worked all term to achieve a higher grade.
ex.zh: 她整个学期都在努力，想取得更高的成绩。

ex.en: The city did not achieve its goal for cutting traffic during the study period.
ex.zh: 在研究期间，这座城市没有实现减少交通量的目标。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: To need something for a particular purpose
To make something necessary through a rule or instruction

ex.en: The lab requires closed shoes and safety glasses.
ex.zh: 实验室要求穿包脚的鞋并戴护目镜。

ex.en: The scholarship will require students to report their progress at the end of each term.
ex.zh: 这份奖学金要求学生在每学期结束时报告进展。

col: be required to do something｜被要求做某事
require further investigation｜需要进一步调查
tip: require sb to do sth表示要求某人做某事。

senses.en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place.
Exist or be found in a particular place or situation.
Come into someone's mind as an idea or thought.

ex.en: The error can occur when the sample is too small.
ex.zh: 样本太小时，这个误差就可能出现。

ex.en: Such storms occur more often when ocean water stays warm later into the fall.
ex.zh: 当海水到秋末仍然偏暖时，这类风暴会更频繁地发生。

tip: 不用于被动语态；过去式occurred，分词occurring。

senses.en: A document that lists the plan, readings, and rules for a course.

ex.en: Check the syllabus before you email the professor.
ex.zh: 给教授发邮件之前先看教学大纲。

ex.en: The syllabus states the grading scale and the policy on late work.
ex.zh: 教学大纲写明了评分标准和迟交作业的规定。

tip: 复数 syllabi 或 syllabuses 都可以。

senses.en: The money used in a particular country.
The state of being widely accepted or used.

ex.en: I copied foreign currency into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把外币抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around foreign currency.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕外币展开说明。

tip: 货币种类可数；泛指货币通常不可数。

senses.en: An official award showing successful completion of education or training.
A skill or quality making someone suitable for a role.
A condition that limits the meaning or acceptance of something.

ex.en: I copied professional qualification into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把职业资格抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of professional qualification.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得职业资格这个例子。

tip: 谈学历或资历常用复数qualifications。

senses.en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion.
To officially announce or give something to people.
One edition of a regularly published newspaper or magazine.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a controversial issue in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了有争议的议题。

ex.en: The reading connects a controversial issue with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把有争议的议题和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a controversial issue｜有争议的议题
tip: issue 作问题常指需讨论的议题，不一定是困难。

senses.en: to surprise someone very much

ex.en: The professor asked us to amaze an audience.
ex.zh: 教授让我们令观众惊叹。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to amaze an audience.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来令观众惊叹。

col: never cease to amaze｜始终令人惊叹
tip: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

senses.en: A person or company that produces something.

ex.en: Our professor circled furniture maker on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了家具制造商。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around furniture maker.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕家具制造商展开说明。

tip: 常与产品名搭配；决策者用decision maker。

senses.en: a way to solve a problem or answer a question
a liquid containing a substance dissolved in it

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a practical solution.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论切实可行的办法。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a practical solution.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论切实可行的办法的材料。

col: a solution to a problem｜问题的解决办法
find a solution｜找到解决办法
a practical solution｜切实可行的办法
tip: 表示“……的解决办法”用solution to，不用solution of。

senses.en: as a result of what has just been stated

ex.en: Therefore, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
ex.zh: 因此，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。

ex.en: Therefore, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
ex.zh: 因此，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。

tip: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。

senses.en: to say something is true, often without providing proof
to ask for or take something you believe is yours
a statement of truth or a request for something owed

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to claim that.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须声称……。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers claim that before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要声称……。

col: make a claim｜提出说法或索赔要求
tip: claim强调某人的说法，不代表已得到证实。

senses.en: Belief in your abilities or in a successful outcome.
Trust that someone or something is reliable.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about lack confidence.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于缺乏信心的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects lack confidence with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把缺乏信心和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: confidence in someone｜对某人的信任
tip: 对某人或某事有信心用confidence in。

senses.en: someone who freely offers to help, usually without payment
to freely offer to do something or give information

ex.en: Office hours began with volunteer work.
ex.zh: 答疑从志愿工作开始。

ex.en: The reading connects volunteer work with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把志愿工作和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: volunteer to help｜主动提出帮忙
volunteer for a charity｜为慈善机构做义工
tip: 自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。

senses.en: Not severe or strong in effect
Pleasantly warm rather than cold
Not strong or spicy in flavour

ex.en: Office hours began with mild symptoms.
ex.zh: 答疑从轻微症状开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used mild symptoms to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用轻微症状来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: mild 可形容症状、天气和味道，不等于“无害”。

senses.en: your spouse's sister, or your sibling's or spouse's sibling's wife

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize sister-in-law in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出姑嫂。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up sister-in-law while discussing evidence about social change.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了姑嫂。

col: future sister-in-law｜未来的嫂子或弟媳
my sister-in-law's family｜我姑嫂的家人
tip: 指姻亲姐妹，不是继姐妹；复数sisters-in-law。

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

senses.zh: 令人惊叹的；令人敬畏的
senses.en: Causing great admiration, wonder, or sometimes fear.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an awesome experience.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论极棒的体验。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an awesome experience.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论极棒的体验的材料。

tip: 表示“超棒”时较口语；正式写作宜选更具体的词。

senses.en: funny or connected with comedy
a publication telling stories through sequences of pictures
a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on comic timing.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论喜剧节奏感。

ex.en: A campus survey used comic timing to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用喜剧节奏感来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: comic可指喜剧相关；comical侧重滑稽可笑。

senses.en: Information in something, or the amount of a substance it contains
Happy with what you have or with your situation
To make someone satisfied with what is available

ex.en: I copied online content into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把网络内容抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects online content with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把网络内容和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: content yourself with｜使自己满足于
tip: 名词重音在前，形容词和动词在后；目录用contents。

senses.en: the process of growing, changing, or becoming more advanced
the process of creating or improving products, land, or services
a new event or change in a situation

ex.en: The textbook introduces economic development in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济发展。

ex.en: The reading connects economic development with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把经济发展和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 泛指发展通常不可数；表示新进展时可数。

senses.en: The condition of being physically healthy and strong.
The quality of being suitable for a task or purpose.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about physical fitness.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于身体素质的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of physical fitness.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得身体素质这个例子。

col: fitness for work｜工作胜任能力
tip: 不可数名词；fitness for表示对某事的适合程度。

senses.en: a short account giving the main points of something
presenting only the main facts or points

ex.en: The textbook introduces a brief summary in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了简短的概要。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a brief summary.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论简短的概要的材料。

tip: a summary of后接概括对象；in summary用于总结。

senses.en: A sculpture representing a person or animal.

ex.en: Our professor circled a bronze statue on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了铜像。

ex.en: A campus survey used a bronze statue to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用铜像来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: statue是雕像；status是地位，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: relating to government, public power, or political parties

ex.en: Our professor circled political party on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了政党。

ex.en: The author returns to political party when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了政党。

tip: political是形容词；politics指政治，politician指政治家。

senses.en: Not costing much money.

ex.en: The textbook introduces relatively inexpensive in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了相对便宜的。

ex.en: A campus survey used relatively inexpensive to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用相对便宜的来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 比cheap更中性，通常不暗示质量差。

senses.en: A person or business acting on behalf of others
Someone secretly gathering information for a government or organisation
A substance or force that produces a particular effect

ex.en: The textbook introduces travel agent in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了旅行代理人。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of travel agent.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得旅行代理人这个例子。

col: an agent of change｜变革推动者
tip: agent不只指特工；cleaning agent中的agent指剂。

senses.en: A place where people do their jobs.

ex.en: The textbook introduces workplace safety in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了工作场所安全。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around workplace safety.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕工作场所安全展开说明。

tip: 泛指办公室、工厂等工作场所，不等于单指办公室。

senses.en: Able to learn, understand, and think well.
Able to process information and respond automatically in useful ways.

ex.en: Our professor circled highly intelligent on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了非常聪明的。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of highly intelligent.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得非常聪明的这个例子。

tip: intelligent指聪明的；intelligible指可理解的。

senses.en: paid work or the state of having a paid job
the use of something for a particular purpose

ex.en: Office hours began with full-time employment.
ex.zh: 答疑从全职工作开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss full-time employment.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论全职工作的材料。

tip: 通常不可数；一份工作用a job，不用an employment。

senses.en: A cream that protects skin from the sun's harmful rays.

ex.en: Office hours began with a tube of suncream.
ex.zh: 答疑从一管防晒霜开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a tube of suncream to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用一管防晒霜来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: a tube of suncream｜一管防晒霜
high-factor suncream｜高防晒系数的防晒霜
tip: 主要用于英式英语，也常写作sun cream。

senses.en: bearing someone's signature as proof of agreement or authorship
wrote a signature to identify oneself or show agreement

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a signed contract.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于已签署的合同的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a signed contract.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论已签署的合同的材料。

col: a signed contract｜已签署的合同
a signed agreement｜已签署的协议
tip: signed可作形容词；“由某人签署”用signed by。

senses.en: Having a condition that limits activities or participation in society.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about disabled people.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于残障人士的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss disabled people.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论残障人士的材料。

col: disabled parking space｜残障人士专用停车位
tip: 可说disabled people或people with disabilities，尊重本人偏好。

senses.en: to provide something that someone needs
the provision or available amount of something needed
essential items kept or provided for use

ex.en: I heard the lecturer supply and demand during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时供求。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers supply and demand before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要供求。

col: supply someone with something｜向某人供应某物
tip: supply A with B＝supply B to A；物资常用supplies。

senses.en: involving all the usual working or studying hours
for all the usual working or studying hours

ex.en: After the lecture, we used full-time in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了全职的。

ex.en: Students who can explain full-time usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释全职的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

tip: 修饰名词时保留连字符，如a full-time job。

senses.en: to calculate a total by adding equal amounts repeatedly
to increase greatly in quantity, or produce more living organisms

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to multiply by.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何乘以。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to multiply by.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来乘以。

tip: A乘以B说multiply A by B；过去式为multiplied。

senses.en: to process used materials so they can be used again

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to recycle household waste.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须回收生活垃圾。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to recycle household waste.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来回收生活垃圾。

col: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾
tip: recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。

senses.en: a formal meeting to discuss a particular subject

ex.en: Office hours began with press conference.
ex.zh: 答疑从新闻发布会开始。

ex.en: The author returns to press conference when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了新闻发布会。

tip: 指正式会议；参加会议用attend a conference。
